title: Match found
one_line: Diagonal house-colour split, both avatars, VS, countdown from 3. Honesty-critical screen.
gaps: Mostly built; confirm the searching state never implies a real opponent is being sought when it is actually filling with a bot, and that the countdown timing matches tokens.json exactly.

anatomy.spec: Animated dots, 'Finding an opponent...'. After roughly 15 s (decision D9), fall back to a labelled BOT and proceed - never keep searching forever, and never fake a 'player found' when it is a bot.
Full-bleed diagonal split, each half in a player's house colour. Avatar with a house ring on each half, name above each, 'VS' centred where the diagonal crosses.
Cream pill, centred, counting 3-2-1, each number scaling in with a punch.
If the opponent is a bot, the name reads clearly as a bot name with a BOT tag next to the avatar - never a human-sounding fake name presented as a real player.

states: Found (real match, once online play ships)
Cancelled - player backs out before the countdown ends, returns to home cleanly
motion: Countdown: each number scales in with a punch, 1 s apart.
data: Matchmaking result: local/bot today, server-owned at T-D2/T-D3.
do_not: Do not claim a real player was found while online play is unbuilt.
Do not search forever with no fallback.
Do not give a bot a name or avatar that could pass as a real player without the BOT tag.
acceptance: Bot fallback fires at ~15s and is clearly labelled.
Countdown reads 3-2-1 and proceeds to the doors.
Cancelling mid-search returns cleanly to Home.
steps: 2. Confirm the 15s bot-fallback timer and the BOT tag rendering.
3. Verify the diagonal split and countdown against tokens.json timings.
5. Capture searching, bot-found and cancel. Postflight.
